query:
SELECT r.id, r.tournamentId, r.tournamentEventId, r.userId, r.status, r.paymentStatus, r.registrationNumber, r.createdAt,
       te.eventType, te.skillLevel
FROM registrations r
LEFT JOIN tournament_events te ON te.id = r.tournamentEventId
WHERE r.tournamentId = 1
AND r.userId IN (
  SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.name LIKE '%임재호%'
)
ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC;
